What is Meerka

The travel guide nobody gives you at the agency

Every destination has its traps. Taxi drivers who invent fares, bracelets that are 'gifted' and then charged for, rigged currency exchanges. Meerka gathers the most reported scams from real travelers and explains how to dodge them before they happen to you.

Search by destination

Filter scams by city or country before you arrive. Get there prepared, not surprised.

Say this

For each scam, Meerka gives you the exact phrase to exit the situation without creating conflict.

Report what you experienced

Did you fall for a trap? Report the scam and help the next traveler. The community is the map.

Tips

Real traveler tips: how to haggle, what to avoid, what actually works on the ground.

How it works

Three steps to travel scam-free

1

Open Meerka before you arrive

Enter your destination and see a list of the most common scams: how to spot them, how they work, and how to dodge them.

2

Save the alerts that matter to you

If something feels off in the moment, a taxi driver, a market, a currency exchange, check the app in seconds.

3

Share what you learned

If you experienced something that's not in the app yet, report it. Every report improves the guide for the next traveler.

The bracelet scam

"I didn't ask for this. I'm not paying for it."

Someone ties a bracelet on your wrist and immediately asks for money. It happens in Paris, Rome, Marrakech, Bangkok. Said calmly, this phrase ends it.
